overall_notes: The paper focuses on schema linking for text-to-SQL parsing, which is a form of code generation (SQL generation from natural language). The human evaluation was focused on schema linking annotation refinement rather than evaluation of generated SQL quality. The paper uses exact match accuracy as the primary automatic evaluation metric. No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted.
